record.paper_title: Open problems on compact constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
record.context_brief: Dirichlet problem under weaker convex-domain bounds
record.original_question: Let Ω be a bounded convex domain, and consider the constant-mean-curvature Dirichlet problem div(Du / sqrt(1 + |Du|²)) = 2H in Ω with boundary condition u = 0 on ∂Ω. Under each of the three assumptions |Ω|H² < π, LH² < 2π, and diam(Ω) < 2/|H|, determine whether this Dirichlet problem is solvable.

evidence.quote: A method to find H-surfaces spanning a given curve is by solving the Dirichlet problem { div Du/sqrt(1+|Du|^2)=2H in Ω; u=φ in ∂Ω }.
Problem 4.1. Let Ω be a bounded convex domain. Solve the Dirichlet problem (4.1) for φ=0 under each one of the following hypothesis: (1) |Ω|H^2<π. (2) LH^2<2π. (3) diam(Ω)<2/|H|.

artifact.category_tag: Constant mean curvature graphs / Dirichlet problem
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem on the solvability of the CMC Dirichlet equation under three weakened convex-domain size hypotheses. Classical sufficient conditions due to Serrin and subsequent refinements give stronger geometric constraints, but a literature search finds no result establishing solvability under any of the three specific hypotheses $|\Omega|H^2<\pi$, $LH^2<2\pi$, or $\operatorname{diam}(\Omega)<2/|H|$ for arbitrary bounded convex planar domains. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Dirichlet problem of the constant mean curvature equation in Lorentz-Minkowski space and in Euclidean space
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing classical Serrin-type solvability criteria for the CMC Dirichlet problem in Euclidean space requiring strong convexity hypotheses on the boundary.
status_evidence.claim: Known solvability results rely on hypotheses stronger than the three listed bounds, leaving the latter open.

status_evidence.title: An alternative solvability criterion for the Dirichlet problem for the minimal surface equation
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work providing alternative solvability criteria related to but distinct from the conditions |Ω|H^2<π, LH^2<2π, diam(Ω)<2/|H|.
status_evidence.claim: No proof of solvability under the three specific hypotheses appears in current literature.
